quest.title: Food Delivery
quest.description: Good Hunter has a delivery service in order to fulfill customers' requests, but due to its popularity, the service is heavily understaffed. Sara is looking for someone to lend a hand.

talks.objective: Talk to Sara at Good Hunter

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Order for delivery

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Traveler! Perfect timing...

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Sorry, I know you must be hungry, but could you do something for me?

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: There's been a steady increase in volume of delivery orders recently. I tend to divide them up by region and then label each dish with the name of the person who ordered it.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: But I've lost the label for this <color=#00E1FFFF>Calla Lily Seafood Soup</color>. All I know is that it's for someone in Springvale.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Could you take this <color=#00E1FFFF>Calla Lily Seafood Soup</color> over to Springvale for me and find out who ordered it?

response.speaker: Sara
response.text: Rest assured there'll be a hearty meal waiting for you on your return!

choices.text: I only came here to eat; I'm starving!

response.speaker: Sara
response.text: Once you've done what I ask, I'll treat you to something from the Good Hunter special menu! Much obliged.

talks.objective: Deliver the food to the buyer

dialogues.speaker: Terrified Schuster
dialogues.text: I wonder if there's anywhere safe to go adventuring...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Excuse me, did you order takeout?

dialogues.speaker: Terrified Schuster
dialogues.text: Wow, that was fast. I thought it would take longer.

dialogues.speaker: Terrified Schuster
dialogues.text: Here's what I owe you. Mmm, smells gooood!

dialogues.speaker: Terrified Schuster
dialogues.text: I mustn't go adventuring on an empty stomach. Now, I'm going to savor every last bite of this...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hello there. Is this your food?

dialogues.speaker: Timid Morrow
dialogues.text: Um... is it Calla Lily Seafood Soup?

dialogues.speaker: Timid Morrow
dialogues.text: Yay, it is mine then. But I'm not sure what took you so long...

dialogues.speaker: Timid Morrow
dialogues.text: Any later and Draff would have dragged me out on a hunt by now.

dialogues.speaker: Timid Morrow
dialogues.text: Ugh, whatever. Here's your money. Now get outta here, let me eat my food in peace.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Excuse me, did you order some takeout?

dialogues.speaker: Reckless Pallad
dialogues.text: Yes, a long time ago! Took you long enough! There'll be no treasure left if I wait much longer.

dialogues.speaker: Reckless Pallad
dialogues.text: Mmm, this does smell delicious though...

dialogues.speaker: Reckless Pallad
dialogues.text: Well, I guess good food is also a treasure worth waiting for. I'm sure I've got time to eat before treasure hunting.

dialogues.speaker: Reckless Pallad
dialogues.text: Thank you. Here's the cash.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Deliver meal fee

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: You're back! Did you manage to deliver it?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Here's the fee.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Let me check... Perfect! Thanks!

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Here, this <color=#00E1FFFF>Crab, Ham & Veggie Bake</color> is for you. It's fresh out of the oven, eat it while it's hot.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sorry to bother you — did you order takeout?

dialogues.speaker: Terrified Schuster
dialogues.text: I did! ...Oh, but this one isn't mine.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hello, did you order food?

dialogues.speaker: Timid Morrow
dialogues.text: Um... Not this, this one isn't mine.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Takeout, get your takeout here...

dialogues.speaker: Reckless Pallad
dialogues.text: Takeout? Not mine.

dialogues.speaker: Timid Morrow
dialogues.text: I wish every day didn't have to be a hunting day...

dialogues.speaker: Reckless Pallad
dialogues.text: Where is the treasure hiding...

dialogues.speaker: Terrified Schuster
dialogues.text: Once I've finished eating I can get on with my adventure...

dialogues.speaker: Timid Morrow
dialogues.text: Yikes... I need to eat up, Draff has nearly finished drinking.

dialogues.speaker: Reckless Pallad
dialogues.text: I'm sure there's time for me to eat before treasure hunting.
